answer: Because each atlas escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the wharf ledger records every share and the ivory audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 88 aliases means 88 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 17 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
